notLevied.why: BW has no contributory social insurance: old-age pension is universal ('Employer Universal: None ... Government Universal: The total cost'), sickness/maternity and work injury are employer-liability systems (benefits paid directly or insured with private carriers), not contributions to a public fund. Secondary source (2019), no later statute creating a contribution found. Human Resource Development Levy is on turnover (not payroll), noted under P7.
